newsitem.title: USA: MARKET FACTS IN EUROPEAN VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: MARKET FACTS IN EUROPEAN VENTURE.

text.p: Market Facts Inc said Friday it has formed a joint venture called Target Europa with two European market research firms.
The joint venture has established a Pan European consumer mail panel of 135,000 households and will coordinate European consumer panel research.

The other companies involved are Taylor Nelson AGB Plc, based in London, England, the largest market research agency in the United Kingdom; and Infratest Burke, headquartered in Munich, the second largest market research firm in Germany.
Market Facts shares were up 3/4 at 15 Friday.
